knowledge:
- key_parameters: object=A SummarizedExperiment object containing the expression data and sample metadata ;; exprmat=A numeric matrix of raw counts or preprocessed expressions (used if object is not provided) ;; covariates=A numeric matrix or character vector of covariates to adjust for ;; variables2test=A design matrix or character string of variables of interest to test ;; which_test=Method to approximate the test, either 'permutation' (recommended for small sample sizes) or 'asymptotic' ;; preprocessed=Logical flag indicating if expression data is already preprocessed (e.g., log-transformed). Default is FALSE ;; genesets=A gene set object (e.g., from BiocSet) containing the gene sets to test in dgsa_seq ;; which_weights=Weighting method for gene-set analysis, e.g., 'loclin' ;; n_perm=Number of permutations to run when which_test is 'permutation'
- alternatives: edgeR=Mentioned for raw count normalization and filtering, and as a comparison method for identifying false positives ;; voom=Mentioned as a similar approach that also uses precision weights to account for heteroscedasticity
- when_to_use: Use when performing gene-wise or gene-set differential expression analysis on RNA-seq data, especially when dealing with complex experimental designs (e.g., multiple biological conditions, repeated measurements, or longitudinal data) and when strict control of the false discovery rate (FDR) is required.
- pitfalls: Using the asymptotic test with small sample sizes (permutation test is preferred for small sample sizes like n=33) ;; Failing to filter out lowly expressed genes before analysis (e.g., filtering genes with CPM > 2 in at least 5 samples is recommended) ;; Incorrectly setting the preprocessed parameter (setting it to TRUE when counts are raw, or FALSE when they are already normalized/log-transformed) ;; Zero-variance genes can cause issues and should be filtered out before running dgsa_seq (e.g., using matrixStats::rowVars)

workflows.name: gene_wise_analysis
workflows.intent: Identify differentially expressed genes from RNA-seq data using the variance component score test.
input: expression_matrix.xlsx (raw or normalized gene expression matrix)
metadata.csv (sample metadata containing variables of interest and covariates)
workflows.stages: 1. Prepare expression data and metadata in a SummarizedExperiment object ;; 2. Filter out lowly expressed genes (if starting from raw counts) ;; 3. Run gene-wise differential analysis using dear_seq() ;; 4. Summarize and plot results using summary() and plot()
workflows.code:
library(dearseq)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
col_data <- data.frame("Status" = infos_df$Status)
col_data$Status <- stats::relevel(col_data$Status, ref="Control")
rownames(col_data) <- infos_df$SampleTitle
se <- SummarizedExperiment(assays = London, 
                            colData = col_data)

res_dearseq <- dearseq::dear_seq(object = se[, se$Status != "LTBI"],
                                 variables2test = "Status",
                                 which_test='asymptotic',
                                 preprocessed=TRUE)
summary(res_dearseq)
plot(res_dearseq)

library(readxl)
library(edgeR)
GEOquery::getGEOSuppFiles('GSE107991', 
                          filter_regex="Raw_counts_Berry_London")
London_raw<- readxl::read_excel("GSE107991/GSE107991_Raw_counts_Berry_London.xlsx")
genes_raw <- London_raw$Genes
London_raw <- as.matrix(London_raw[,-c(1:3)])

se_raw <- SummarizedExperiment(assays = London_raw, 
                            colData = col_data)

group <- ifelse(se_raw$Status=="ActiveTB",1,0)
dgList <- DGEList(counts = London_raw, group = group)
cpm <- cpm(dgList)
countCheck <- cpm > 2
keep <- which(rowSums(countCheck) >= 5)
London_raw <- London_raw[keep,]

res_dearseq <- dearseq::dear_seq(object = se_raw[ , se_raw$Status != "LTBI"],
                                 variables2test = "Status",
                                 which_test='permutation',
                                 preprocessed=FALSE, 
                                 parallel_comp = interactive())

summary(res_dearseq)
plot(res_dearseq)

workflows.name: gene_set_analysis
workflows.intent: Perform gene-set analysis on RNA-seq data using the variance component score test.
input: metadata.csv (sample metadata containing covariates and variables of interest)
workflows.stages: 1. Prepare expression data and metadata in a SummarizedExperiment object ;; 2. Filter out genes with zero variance ;; 3. Run gene-set analysis using dgsa_seq() ;; 4. Summarize results using summary() ;; 5. Visualize longitudinal expression within a gene set using spaghettiPlot1GS()
workflows.code:
library(dearseq)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(BiocSet)
data('baduel_5gs')
se2 <- SummarizedExperiment(assay = log2(expr_norm_corr+1), 
                            colData = design)
genes_non0var_ind <- which(matrixStats::rowVars(expr_norm_corr)!=0)

KAvsTBG <- dearseq::dgsa_seq(object = se2[genes_non0var_ind, ],
                             covariates=c('Vernalized', 'AgeWeeks', 'Vernalized_Population', 'AgeWeeks_Population'),
                             variables2test = 'PopulationKA',
                             genesets=baduel_gmt$genesets[c(3,5)],
                             which_test = 'permutation', which_weights = 'loclin',
                             n_perm=2000, preprocessed = TRUE,
                             verbose = FALSE, 
                             parallel_comp = interactive())
summary(KAvsTBG)
KAvsTBG$pvals

Cold <- dearseq::dgsa_seq(object = se2[genes_non0var_ind, ],
                          covariates = c('AgeWeeks', 'PopulationKA', 'AgeWeeks_Population'),
                          variables2test = c('Vernalized', 'Vernalized_Population'),
                          genesets = baduel_gmt$genesets[c(3,5)],
                          which_test = 'permutation', which_weights = 'loclin',
                          n_perm = 2000, preprocessed = TRUE, 
                          verbose = FALSE, 
                          parallel_comp = interactive())
summary(Cold)
Cold$pvals

colData(se2)[["Indiv"]] <- colData(se2)[["Population"]]:colData(se2)[["Replicate"]]
colData(se2)[["Vern"]] <- ifelse(colData(se2)[["Vernalized"]], "Vernalized", "Non-vernalized")

library(ggplot2)
spaghettiPlot1GS(gs_index = 3, gmt = baduel_gmt, expr_mat = assay(se2), 
  design = colData(se2), var_time = AgeWeeks, var_indiv = Indiv, 
  sampleIdColname = "sample", var_group=Vern, var_subgroup=Population, loess_span = 1.5) +
  ggplot2::xlab("Age (weeks)")
